pr.title: Chapter 11: NHWA's 29 indicators as draft L2 indicator blocks (change set #95)
pr.body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"litlfred"} -->
_Requested by **litlfred** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G9?thread=cmsg_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G9BqMrkUVdrizRYAtGR9Acd4)_

Stacked on #94 (base `claude/dth-hrh-cde-nhwa`). Change set #95.

## What

All 29 indicators of the NHWA handbook, 2nd edition, as draft L2 `indicator` blocks in Chapter 11. Each one sits in its NHWA module section (11.2 to 11.5), right after the module's opening block and before its data elements.

| Section | Indicators |
|---|---|
| 11.2 Module 1: Stock and flow | 1-01 to 1-12 |
| 11.3 Module 2: Education | 2-01 to 2-07 |
| 11.4 Module 3: Finance and expenditures | 3-01 to 3-05 |
| 11.5 Module 4: Working conditions, governance and leadership | 4-01 to 4-05 |

- Every field is copied word for word from the ingested L1 node in who-iris (`library/9789240081291-eng`, who-iris#171), with ids as printed. `meta` uses the structured-card keys (`indicatorId`, `module`, `numerator`, `denominator`, `disaggregation`, `dataSources`, ...) plus `source.node` (the L1 IRI) and `programIndicatorId` (`NHWA.1-01`).
- When the handbook prints no numerator, denominator or disaggregation (11 indicators, mostly the composite and self-assessed ones in modules 2 to 4), the block says so and `meta.gaps` lists it. Nothing is filled in.
- Composite indicators list their sub-indicators (2-07, 4-01, 4-02, 4-05).
- Each block lists the chapter's data elements that support it, read from #94's `meta.supportsIndicators`.
- `.jsonld` siblings and `review-anchors.json` regenerated.

## Checks run locally

`check:kg-blocks`, `check:review-anchors`, `check:dth-glossary`, `check:page-furniture`, `wg:changesets:check`: all pass.

## Notes

- The L1 IRIs resolve once who-iris#171 merges (after #165).
- No 2015 MDS reference.

**Committee content (change set #95).** Not to be merged by an agent.
